job.description:

Reconciliations · Reconcile general and trust bank accounts · Maintain accurate general ledger and trust ledgers · Ensure compliance with the Uniform Law General Rules on Trust Accounting

AP/AR & Cashflow · Manage accounts payable and receivable · Process trust-to-office transfers, reimbursements, and supplier payments · Oversee cashflow management for the firm and related entities controlled by the Founding Director.

Payroll & Compliance · Administer payroll, superannuation, and Single Touch Payroll (STP) · Prepare and lodge payroll tax returns · Manage employee entitlements (leave, bonuses, parental leave) · Administer Parental Leave payments and top-ups in line with policy

Taxation · Liaise with external tax consultants on Company Tax Return compliance · Provide reconciliations for year-end compliance with external accountants · Prepare and lodge BAS, IAS, FBT, PAYG and other statutory obligations

Debtors · Management and reporting of debtors, including ensuring reduction of overall lock-up

Dividends & Shares · Calculate and process dividends · Determine distributable surplus and manage franking credits · Issue dividend statements · Assist with share issuance and administration (registry updates, transfers, documentation)

Governance and Risk · Coordinate the yearly external trust account audit · Prepare reconciliations and supporting documentation · Liaise with auditors to ensure compliance

Director Support · Manage and maintain the Founding Director’s personal payments (processing, reconciliations, analysis) · Maintain books for related entities including AP/AR, tax compliance, and cashflow · Liaise with the Directors’ accountant on yearly income tax return · Liaise with third parties to assist with ad hoc tasks (e.g. Director of other entities)

Internal Controls · Implement and maintain controls over reconciliations, trust funds, dividends, loans, shares, related entities, and personal payments; · Monitor and review work-in-progress (WIP) to ensure profitability of the firm; · Support external audits and process improvements.

job.title: Senior Auditor
job.description:
Senior Auditor | Perth | Public Practice

Our client is a long standing Perth practice with a strong reputation in the local market, built on the calibre of clients they act for. Expect exposure to some genuinely complex, multi entity groups and a large focus on the mining sector. 

What you'll be doing
  • Running audit engagements from planning through to sign off
  • Leading and mentoring junior staff on your jobs
  • Managing your own client relationships (you'll actually talk to clients, not just review someone else's file)
  • Reviewing financial statements and flagging risk areas
  • Having real input into how the team runs its audit process, not just following it
What we're looking for
  • CA or CPA qualified, or close to finishing
  • A few years' audit experience in public practice
  • Solid technical audit and reporting skills
  • Comfortable leading a small team and dealing directly with clients
  • Keen to help junior staff coming up behind you
On offer
  • Full study support through to CA/CPA
  • A real path to Audit Manager
  • Hybrid working, no rigid five days in office
  • Decent systems, so you're not stuck doing manual admin all day
  • Professional development and structured training

This search is confidential, so if you're keen to hear more before committing to anything, reach out to Faith on 0424336058

job.title: Client Services Administrator
job.description:
Client Services Administrator Perth CBD | Attractive salary based on experience + Super About the firm

Join a well-established and highly regarded accounting practice based in Perth CBD, known for its strong client relationships and supportive team culture. This is a great opportunity to join a firm that values efficiency, collaboration, and genuine career development.

About the role

We're looking for a switched-on Client Services Administrator to provide centralised support across the practice, helping to streamline client-related services and free up time for the accounting team to focus on higher-value work. You'll work closely with managers and senior consultants, liaising directly with clients and external service providers, so this role suits someone who's organised, proactive, and comfortable juggling a variety of tasks.

What you'll be doing
  • Preparing and finalising completed client compliance work
  • Managing lodgements and liaising with the ATO on clients' behalf
  • Keeping client details up to date across government portals
  • Coordinating annual reviews and other secretarial obligations for corporate clients
  • Handling day-to-day client requests and general admin support
What we're looking for
  • Previous experience in an administration or client services role within an accounting or professional services environment (highly regarded but not essential)
  • Essential: hands-on experience with ASIC and ATO portals
  • Strong attention to detail and a genuine willingness to support the team
  • Excellent communication skills, comfortable liaising directly with clients and external providers
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office
What's on offer
  • Attractive salary based on experience
  • Perth CBD location
  • Supportive, close-knit team environment
  • Genuine opportunity to build your skills within a reputable practice
Ready to take the next step? Apply now, we'd love to hear from you.
